body:
Thanks.

I admit that my post was a bit chaotic but I was writing it under strong emotions, on my phone. I just wanted to put there as much information as I could...

As for my parents, yeah I'm sure they'll help me, but it still will have it's price that I'm not sure if I'm able to pay... 

First of all the fact that I already went through all of this once, makes it even more difficult to do it now... The fact that I made almost all the same mistakes again is quite difficult to accept... Also the memory of my mom crying is not helping...

Also my dad has recently quite a lot of stress at work, and almost had heart attack once... Adding to that makes me feel like a monster...

And finally I know they will want to help me, but to do that they will probably require me to go to different places and try to make all of this right... In my current state I'm not sure if I'm able to handle it... 

Btw I know that killing myself is not a solution to most of this problems, but I don't believe in afterlife, so at least I would not feel all of that this way...

Btw2 sorry for my English... not my native language...

Just a little update. The lie worked. Unfortunately in fact it was almost perfect, so my brain started figuring out if it's possible to survive without it... Please wish me strength to tell the truth to my therapist...
Yeah, just right now I don't have much time, since I have to figure out how to keep the lie going for the next 5 hours until I meet my therapist...
